description: This file defines a class SparkSubmitOptionParser that encapsulates parsing logic for spark-submit command line options, including constants for options, parsing methods, and callback methods for handling options and arguments.

classes.name: SparkSubmitOptionParser
classes.description: A parser class for handling spark-submit command line options, including constants, option lists, and parsing logic.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses a list of command line arguments for spark-submit options, invoking callbacks for recognized options.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Callback invoked when a recognized option with a value is parsed.

methods.name: handleUnknown
methods.description: Callback invoked when an unrecognized option is encountered.

methods.name: handleExtraArgs
methods.description: Callback invoked with remaining arguments after parsing is complete.

methods.name: findCliOption
methods.description: Finds the canonical option name for a given command line argument from a list of available options.
